latest_release.name: Horizon 0.2.97: Prepare, signs and 16 more fixes
latest_release.body:
> **Outdated.** Horizon now ships as the **Nightly** release (built from main every few hours): get it through the launcher at https://playhorizon.dev or from the [Nightly release](https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon/releases/tag/nightly). GitHub keeps calling this one "Latest" only because Nightly is a pre-release.

Want to play? Download the Horizon launcher, not the files below

It installs this version and keeps it up to date. It is also on GitHub: the launcher releases. You need your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. The files below are what the launcher installs, and the dedicated server for people who host one.

### Fixed - item pickup: a stack in the off hand fills before the inventory, as getSlotWithRemainingSpace does (#3067, fixes #2865) - death message: a creeper's blast names the creeper, not the last mob that hit (#3068, fixes #2978) - riding: the crosshair skips the mob being ridden, so it can't be hit (#3069, fixes #2870) - boat: the view stops at 105 degrees at every turn, so it doesn't jitter (#3070, fixes #2983) - HUD paint: build the sprite key in one reused buffer (#3083) - Inventory draw: a slot is drawn from a reference, not a copy (#3086) - Creative screen: draw the selected tab from a reference (#3092) - Server list: build each row's sprite key once (#3095) - Effect panels: borrow the name and reuse the icon key (#3097) - Name tags: copy a custom name only inside the tag's range (#3100) - Crowded mobs take cramming damage, as vanilla (#3124) - Shulker bullets are drawn as the spinning bullet model, not a flat sprite (#3127, fixes #3115) - fix(windows): open URLs with the registered protocol handler (#3210) - Chat and book links: a show_dialog click event opens its dialog (#3238, fixes #3204) - Pin the turtle's walk animation to vanilla's rate (#2748, fixes #1776) - The spawn egg's offspring is a named, tested rule (#2791, fixes #2269) - Signs: keep laid-out sign text between frames (3458 signs: 124 → 222 fps) (#3284, fixes #1461) - Prepare: accept Mojang's fifth 26.3 republish (5df1795e, index 917ff6d7) (#3318) ### Known issues - Shader packs have been removed for now. They will come back later, written again from scratch. Packs in your `shaderpacks` folder are left where they are. Thanks to @Domanffe, @PH4N7OMx, @degepie, @iLostName, @kacpherek, @levzzz5154, @masa-masa-0314. Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

detail.readme_excerpt:
Website · Download · Docs · Discord · Roadmap · Contributing

# Horizon **Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, rewritten in Rust.** Your worlds, the same rules and the same terrain as the Java game, checked against it by hundreds of differential tests, in one native program with no Java. Free, open source (MIT) and unofficial: you play it with your own copy of Java Edition.

## What works today Everything below is in the current release. - **The game.** Survival, creative, hardcore and spectator; vanilla world generation in all three dimensions, mobs, villagers, raids, redstone, every command, the HUD and the recipe book. Vanilla saves open as they are, and worlds from 1.8 to 26.2 are upgraded. - **Multiplayer.** Join vanilla and Horizon servers (online mode included), open a world to LAN, or invite friends with a code from the launcher's Home page. - **Graphics.** Distant terrain up to 1,024 chunks, graphics presets, HDR and controllers, all off by default where they would change the vanilla look ([settings](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/settings)). - **Packs.** Resource packs, data packs and shader packs ([below](#mods-and-shader-packs)). - **Mods.** Content mods and native Rust mods, installed from the launcher ([below](#mods-and-shader-packs)). - **Servers.** Host one from the launcher, or run `horizon-server` on a VPS ([below](#host-a-server)). - **The launcher.** It installs and updates the game, prepares its files from your copy of Minecraft, and updates itself.
